title: The capture-free move count runs out and draws the game
rationale: Xiangqi ends a game that has run fifty moves — a hundred plies — without a capture. Only a capture resets the count: there is no piece whose move resets it, so four quiet rook moves from a position already at ninety-six carry it to a hundred and the game is drawn, automatically rather than on a claim. The boundary two plies earlier is still ongoing, which is what makes this the rule's exact edge. Mini Xiangqi has no such rule, so this outcome can never arise there; mx-cnt-001 is the same question answered the other way.
